snippet.title: The Green Hill 8 – Announce Trailer #SHC2026
snippet.description:
A Sonic 1 ROM hack inspired by The Exit 8, coming to the Sonic Hacking Contest 2026. Stay tuned!

*About:* We've all seen the beginning of Green Hill Zone Act 1 countless times over the years. Perhaps one could even say you've got every last detail of those first few seconds of Sonic 1's iconic opening stage memorized. Well then, you shouldn't have trouble spotting anything that doesn't belong, right?

Download link (once the contest begins on October 23): https://shc.zone/entries/contest2026/1440

If you aren't familiar with The Exit 8, take a look at its Steam page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2653790/The_Exit_8
